```{r}

  reorderFigures = params$reorderFigures;
```

```{r}
#| label: setup_RPT

  require(ggplot2);
```

Updates to GMACS since the September 2025 Crab Plan Team (CPT) meeting are listed in the following tables. Text highlighted in red indicates a change in input model format or other important information.

```{r, results='asis'}
#| label: tbl_202604a
  tblno = tblno+1;
  cap = paste0("Table ",LETTERS[tblno],". ",
               "Updates to GMACS 2025-12-30 to 2026-03-19. Versions 2.20.32 - 2.20.35.\n");
  cat(cap);
  fn = "UpdatesTable_202604a.pdf";
  kbl = wtsQMD::imageAsKable(fn);
  cat(kbl,"\n\n");
  rm(cap,kbl);
```
